extension.description: Runs only the .NET test methods your change can reach: on save, a Roslyn analyzer finds the impacted tests, and only their test projects are built and run.
untrustedWorkspaces.description: Aftershock builds and runs the workspace's code, which needs a trusted workspace.
virtualWorkspaces.description: Aftershock runs dotnet on the local file system.
config.solution: Solution (`.sln` or `.slnx`) to analyze, absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Empty: the first solution in the workspace root (by name), else the shallowest one below it.
config.debounceMs: Time to wait after a save before analyzing (milliseconds). Further saves in this time are analyzed together.
config.maxImpactedSymbols: Limit of the caller search per changed file (non-test symbols). Above it, the dependent test projects run completely. `0` means no limit.
config.fallbackGlobs: Files whose change runs the dependent test projects completely (relative to the repository or solution folder; a pattern without `/` matches the file name anywhere). Setting a value replaces the default.
config.testFilter: Extra VSTest filter for every run, for example `Category!=Integration`. Combined with the selection as `(<selection>)&(<filter>)`. For xUnit v3 on Microsoft.Testing.Platform, simple `Trait=Value` / `Trait!=Value` terms are translated.
config.disableAnalyzersInBuild: Turn off Roslyn analyzers in Aftershock's builds (`-p:RunAnalyzers=false`) for faster feedback. Your normal builds and CI are not affected.
config.dotnetPath: The `dotnet` executable used to run the analyzer, builds and tests.
config.coverageEnabled: Collect coverage in Aftershock's test runs and show the coverage of new code (lines added or changed relative to the target branch). Off: no coverage arguments, decorations or numbers.
config.targetBranch: Branch that defines new code: new lines are those added or changed in the working tree relative to `git merge-base HEAD <branch>`. Empty: `origin/HEAD`, then `origin/main`, `origin/master`, `origin/develop`.
config.coverageThreshold: New-code coverage target in percent, used for the warning color and the "N more to reach the target" number. A threshold read from the SonarQube quality gate will take precedence once Sonar is connected.
config.coverageTool: Coverage tool. Use the one your Sonar pipeline uses: tools count branches differently. VSTest projects need `coverlet.collector` (coverlet) or `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk` (microsoft); Microsoft.Testing.Platform projects need `coverlet.MTP` or `Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage`.
config.coverageTool.coverlet: coverlet: `--collect "XPlat Code Coverage"` (VSTest) or `--coverlet` (Microsoft.Testing.Platform), Cobertura output.
config.coverageExclusions: Files that do not count for new-code coverage, as glob patterns relative to the repository or solution folder (for example `**/Migrations/**`; a pattern without `/` matches the file name anywhere). Keep it in sync with the project's `sonar.coverage.exclusions`. Test projects never count.
config.coverageDecorations: Mark new lines in the editor: uncovered lines red, lines with uncovered conditions yellow (gutter and line background).
color.uncoveredLineBackground: Background of new lines that no test covers (Aftershock).
color.partialLineBackground: Background of new lines with uncovered conditions (Aftershock).
color.uncoveredLineRuler: Overview ruler mark of new lines that no test covers (Aftershock).
color.partialLineRuler: Overview ruler mark of new lines with uncovered conditions (Aftershock).
